Owe Philadelphia Property Tax? Get a Cash Offer

We buy Philadelphia houses as-is. The title company pays unpaid tax from the proceeds.

Call or Text  (424) 435-2326


Last updated November 14, 2026. Citations come from Pennsylvania statutes and official agency pages linked in Sources. Where we could not confirm something on an official page, we say so.

Philadelphia property tax is billed by the offices named below. This guide points to them and explains what happens to unpaid tax when you sell.

Who bills what in Philadelphia

  • Office of Property Assessment handles assessment.
  • Philadelphia Department of Revenue bills and collects the tax.

Due dates

Real Estate Tax payments due March 31 each year; bills usually mailed in December; additions accrue 1.5%/month from April 1. See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Appeal to Board of Revision of Taxes (BRT); must be filed by the first Monday in October of the year before the tax year (Oct 5, 2026 for tax year 2027 per BRT search excerpt). See the official page.

Tax rate

The official page we opened lists 1.3998% of assessed value (0.6159% City + 0.7839% School District) for 2025. See the official page.

Local notes

  • City and county are coterminous; Philadelphia sub-est row is place-level only
  • Homestead exemption $80,000 (opened page)
Behind on Philadelphia property tax?
We buy Philadelphia houses as-is, and the title company pays unpaid tax from the proceeds.
Get My Cash Offer →

How to sell a house in Philadelphia when you owe property tax

  1. Find out what the title company needs. For an inherited or transferred house, that usually means the recorded deed or the Register of Wills paperwork that shows who owns it today.
  2. Get a payoff for any mortgage and the amount of any unpaid property tax. Both are paid from the sale proceeds at closing.
  3. Compare offers on what you net after repairs, commissions and closing costs, not on the headline price.
  4. If you want a fast, simple closing, ask for a written cash offer. We buy houses as-is, with no repairs and no agent commission. See we buy houses in Pennsylvania.

Philadelphia property tax guide FAQ

When are Philadelphia property taxes due?

See the due dates section above and confirm with the collector.

What happens to unpaid Philadelphia property tax when I sell?

The title company pays unpaid tax from the sale proceeds at closing.
